description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to high-quality patient care and support our nursing team in a dynamic environment. If you are a compassionate leader with a commitment to excellence, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and fostering a positive work environment. This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, with a strong preference for candidates who hold a Registered Nurse (RN) license. Join a team that values your expertise and dedication to resident well-being.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership and supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This vital role involves managing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process, ensuring accurate and timely assessments, and developing comprehensive care plans for residents. The ideal candidate will play a key role in maintaining regulatory compliance and optimizing resident outcomes.

This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $32-$36. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about quality care and has a strong understanding of the MDS process. If you are an RN with a commitment to excellence in long-term care, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
In-depth knowledge of MDS 3.0 and federal/state regulations
Strong assessment, care planning, and documentation skills
Ability to collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary teams

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physician specializing in Internal Medicine-Pediatrics to join a reputable healthcare facility in Greenville, SC. This role offers a highly competitive compensation package starting at $210,000 annually, complemented by a robust bonus structure including a $25,000 guaranteed bonus and an additional $25,000 potential bonus. A significant $9,000 portion of the bonus is available on day one upon signing a promissory note.

This position comes with excellent benefits and generous paid time off, supporting a healthy work-life balance. While full-time is preferred, we are open to considering qualified candidates for part-time or contract arrangements. We welcome physicians open to travel or relocation to the vibrant community of Greenville.
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification or Eligibility in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Med-Peds
Current, unrestricted state medical license (or eligible for licensure)
Willingness to relocate or travel for the position
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $210,000 per year, with a $25,000 guaranteed bonus and an additional $25,000 potential bonus. A $9,000 portion of the bonus is payable on day one upon signing a promissory note.

description: Join a premier medical center in Winslow, AZ, dedicated to providing exceptional patient care. We are seeking a skilled Physical Therapist to join our dynamic team, offering both full-time and part-time opportunities to fit your lifestyle.In this vital role, you will have the unique opportunity to work across diverse settings, providing comprehensive physical therapy services to both inpatients within our Critical Access Hospital and outpatients at our dedicated stand-alone clinic. This position offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being in a supportive community environment.
requirements: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree or equivalent.
Experience working with both inpatient and outpatient populations.
Strong clinical assessment and treatment skills.
